City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JANUARY 16, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
City Clerk to Administer Oath of Office to appointed City Council Member Kellie Shay Hinze
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Resolution 2019-10 committing the City of Encinitas to providing matching funds in the amount of $4,338,000 for the 2019 SANDAG Regional Competition Active Transportation Grant Program for N. Coast Highway 101 Streetscape, Segment A and appointing the Director of Development Services as the designee to execute grant agreements with SANDAG. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Kellar
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-10 entitled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Committing the City of Encinitas to Providing Grant Matching Costs for the 2019 Active Transportation Program for the SANDAG Regional Competition and Appointing the Director Of Development Services as the Authorized Representative to Accept Grant Funding and Execute Grant Agreements with SANDAG.”
2019-01-16 Item 08A Streetscape SANDAG ATP Grant 2019
8B.
Authorization for the City Manager to sign contract Amendment #3 with Kimley-Horn for additional costs and a revised scope of work to complete the Housing Plan Update. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to sign Contract Amendment #3 (in substantial form) with Kimley-Horn for additional costs and a revised scope of work for completion of the Housing Plan for a total amount not to exceed $582,208.
2019-01-16 Item 08B Amendment to Kimley Horn Contract on Housing Plan Update
8C.
Authorize annual software maintenance for Cityworks work order management system. Contact Person: IT Applications Supervisor Van Pelt
City Council take the following action: 1) Authorize the Cityworks annual software maintenance renewal with Azteca Systems in an amount not to exceed $22,650 in FY 2018-19, and authorize anticipated Cityworks annual software maintenance renewals in amounts not to exceed $65,000 in FY 2019-20; and $65,000 in FY 2020-21. The total contract expenditures for Cityworks through FY 2020-21 will be a not to exceed amount of $512,100.
2019-01-16 Item 08C Annual Software Maintenance (ASM) for Cityworks Work Order Management System
8D.
Introduction of Ordinance 2019-03 establishing a New Speed Limit on North Coast Highway 101. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Introduce Ordinance 2019-03 entitled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California, Establishing Speed Limits” on North Coast Highway 101.
2019-01-16 Item 08D Establish New Speed Limit North Highway 101 - Encinitas Blvd. to La Costa Ave.
8E.
Award of Contract for professional services for preparation of the Encinitas Rail Corridor “Cross Connect” Implementation Plan (WC19D) in an amount not to exceed $247,600. Contact Person: Principal Planner Langager
Approve the Professional Services Agreement between the City of Encinitas and WSP USA, Inc. (WSP), in substantial form and authorize the City Manager to execute the same, subject to review and final approval of the City Attorney in order to develop the Rail Corridor “Cross Connect” Implementation Plan (CCIP).
2019-01-16 Item 08E Cross Connect Contract Award
8F.
Contract Amendment #2 for Infrastructure Engineering Corporation (IEC) to Provide Additional Design and Permitting Services on Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project (CC04J). Contact Person: Associate Civil Engineer Widelski
City Council take the following action: 1) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract amendment in substantial form, and any necessary extensions, with Infrastructure Engineering Corporation (IEC) in the amount of $139,544 plus 15% contingency to perform additional design and permitting services for the Olivenhain Trunk Sewer Project, for a total amendment amount not to exceed $160,476 for a total overall contract amount of $635,559.
2019-01-16 Item 08F Olivenhain Trunk Sewer - Amendment #2 IEC Contract
2019-01-16 Item 08F Corrected Page 1
8G.
Authorize network security firewall annual support renewals. Contact Person: IT Operations Supervisor Contreras
The City Council take the following actions: 1) Ratify the procurement of annual Firewall support renewals in the amount of $3,184 previously spent; and 2) Authorize Firewall license annual support renewals for City Hall and the San Dieguito Water District in an amount not to exceed $16,223 in FY 2018-19 using the National Organization of State Procurement Officials (NASPO) ValuePoint (AR626) and California Participating Addendum No. 7-14-70-11, for overall contract amount not to exceed $89,452.
2019-01-16 Item 08G Firewall Annual Renewal
8H.
Fiscal Year 2018-19 First Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
1) Receive and file the Fiscal Year 2018-19 First Quarter Budget Status Report; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-05 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget.”
2019-01-16 Item 08H Fiscal Year 2018-19 First Quarter Budget Status Report and Proposed Budget Amendments
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Memorandum of Understanding and Temporary Right-of-Way Parking License Agreement with the North County Transit District. Contact Person: Director of Development Services Wisneski
1) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the Memorandum of Understanding and License Agreement (Agreement) with the North County Transit District (NCTD) in substantial form for temporary use of the NCTD right-of-way for parking; 2) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute an agreement with Michael Baker International (MBI) in an amount of $51,000 for the survey of the east and west NCTD right-of-way from Encinitas Boulevard to La Costa Avenue, Agreement plats and legal descriptions of the license area; 3) Authorize the City Manager, or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute as-needed contract amendment #3 with LC Paving & Sealing, Inc. (LC Paving) in an amount of $160,000 for minimal grading to remedy potential ruts and significant grade differentials in the license area, and related work, for a total not to exceed amount of $1,496,500; 4) Authorize a 10% contingency on all work, for a total not-to-exceed contract amount of $21,100; and 5) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2019-09 entitled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget.”
2019-01-16 Item 10A North County Transit District Memorandum Of Understanding and Temporary Right-of-Way License Agreement
10B.
Presentation of the City’s Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR) for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2018. Contact Person: Finance Manager Huang
Accept and file the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2018.
2019-01-16 Item 10B Comprehensive Annual Financial Report 2018
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS

2019-01-16 Item 15 City Manager Follow Up Log

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON FEBRUARY 13, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
